answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring nodes to lock capital to validate transactions. Much like a summit requires endurance to reach, this economic hurdle ensures that scaling a network of malicious identities becomes a financial gale that depletes an attacker's resources. By imposing a steep cost on capital acquisition, the system maintains a stable mesa of decentralized integrity, forcing adversarial agents to bear the full weight of their own failed attacks.
